## Default paid domain research
A direct current-user request for a named public business domain starts one standard DataForSEO search without ownership, permission, market-code, language-code, or second payment-confirmation questions. Australia and English are the defaults. An explicit refresh or deep request selects that mode. The workflow checks a 24-hour same-market cache, uses only fixed reviewed DataForSEO endpoints, and never retries a paid call automatically.

Every component records success, no_results, failed, unavailable, or skipped. Failed attempts are saved without replacing the latest successful company memory.

parameters.url: ={{ 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/paid-domain-research?domain=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Paid Research Input').item.json.domain) + '&sessionId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Paid Research Input').item.json.sessionId) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sessionId: $('Validate Paid Research Input').item.json.sessionId, jobId: $('Validate Paid Research Input').item.json.jobId, domain: $('Validate Paid Research Input').item.json.domain }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const i=$('Validate Paid Research Input').first().json,registered=$json.job?.jobId===i.jobId&&$json.job?.domain===i.domain,response=registered?null:{ok:false,saved:false,jobId:i.jobId,actualCostUsd:0,costLimitUsd:i.costLimitUsd,error:{code:'JOB_REGISTRATION_FAILED',message:'Paid research was not started because the job could not be linked to this conversation.'}};return{json:{...i,registered,...(response?{response}:{})}};

const i=$('Validate Paid Research Input').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,saved:false,error:{code:'PAID_RESEARCH_FAILED',message:'Paid domain research could not be completed.'}};
return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:i.sessionId,requestId:i.requestId,toolName:'start_paid_domain_research',proposedInput:JSON.stringify(i.proposedInput??{}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??r.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The result could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
